rules.title: Annual General Adjustment (AGA) for Year 2026
rules.requirement: Eligible landlords may increase the 2025 permanent rent ceilings by 1.0% no earlier than January 1, 2026, which is 65% of the CPI increase for the Bay Area from July 1, 2024 to June 30, 2025.
rules.summary_plain: If you rent in Berkeley, your landlord can raise your rent by up to 1.0% starting January 1, 2026, based on the local cost of living increase.
rules.summary_plain_es: Si alquilas en Berkeley, tu arrendador puede aumentar tu renta hasta un 1.0% a partir del 1 de enero de 2026, basado en el aumento local del costo de vida.
rules.coverage_conditions_text: Applies to eligible landlords and tenants with tenancy beginning before January 1, 2025, excluding those with rents set under Costa-Hawkins Rental Housing Act after that date.

conditions.note: Tenancy began before January 1, 2025, rents set before that date

rules.exemptions_text: Tenants whose tenancy began on or after January 1, 2025, with rents set pursuant to the Costa-Hawkins Rental Housing Act are not subject to this increase.
rules.citation: Berkeley Municipal Code section 13.76.110A; Rent Board Regulation 1148
rules.quoted_span: At its regular meeting on October 16, 2025, the Berkeley Rent Stabilization Board adopted the Annual General Adjustment (AGA) Order for Year 2026 which will allow eligible landlords to increase the 2025 permanent rent ceilings by 1.0% no earlier than January 1, 2026. The 2026 AGA of 1.0% represents 65% of the increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) for All Urban Consumers in the Bay Area during the period from July 1, 2024 - June 30, 2025, which was 1.5% as posted by the Bureau of Labor Statistics.
